title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 7 review: objects, clothes and shopping
subtitle: Common objects, clothes, colours and shopping phrases (Unit 7)

words.def: a thing that gives light in a room
words.sent: It’s dark here. Can you turn on the ___ on the desk?

words.def: a thing on the wall that shows the time
words.sent: Look at the ___ on the wall — it’s ten o’clock.

words.def: a thing you sit on, with four legs and a back
words.sent: Please sit on this ___.

words.def: a green living thing in a pot
words.sent: There’s a green ___ next to the window.

words.def: a big bag you take on a trip for your clothes
words.sent: I’m going on holiday. My clothes are in my ___.

words.def: a music instrument with six strings
words.sent: He plays the ___ in a band.

words.def: one thing near me
words.sent: I like ___ lamp here — it’s near me.

words.def: one thing not near me
words.sent: Who’s ___ man over there?

words.def: two or more things near me
words.sent: How much are ___ cups here?

words.def: two or more things not near me
words.sent: Look at ___ plates over there — they’re beautiful.

words.def: a short coat you wear over a shirt
words.sent: Tom Ford wears a white shirt and a dark grey ___.

words.def: a woman’s piece of clothing that hangs from the waist
words.sent: Carolina Herrera usually wears a black ___.

words.def: clothes for your legs, one part for each leg
words.sent: He’s wearing black ___ and a white shirt.

words.def: a piece of clothing for a woman, top and skirt in one
words.sent: Michelle usually wears a red ___.

words.def: nearer to black, not light
words.sent: Tom Ford’s jacket is nearly black — it’s ___ grey.

words.vi: tôi có thể giúp gì cho bạn?
words.def: what a shop assistant says to a customer
words.sent: Shop assistant: “___” — Customer: “Yes, how much are these cups?”

words.def: a question about the price of one thing
words.sent: I like this lamp. ___ — It’s £15.

words.def: a polite way to say I want
words.sent: ___ two of these cups, please.

words.vi: đây ạ (khi đưa cho ai cái gì)
words.def: what you say when you give someone something
words.sent: That’s ten pounds, please. — ___.

words.def: a small paper from the shop that shows what you paid
words.sent: Thank you. And here’s your ___.
